snippet.title: Rails & Rivals Trailer
snippet.description:
Rails & Rivals is a turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 6 players. Build railroad networks on a hex map, deliver goods between cities, and outmaneuver your opponents for the highest score.

Coming to Steam, July 2026.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4360900/Rails__Rivals/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=wishlist&utm_content=trailer

Lay track across plains, mountains, and rivers. Each terrain type has a cost. Issue bonds for quick capital, but you will pay dividends every turn. Upgrade your locomotive to reach cities further down the line. Convert gray towns into active destinations to reshape the board.

FEATURES:
Hex-based track building with terrain costs,
Goods delivery across shared railroad networks,
Bonds and dividends,
Engine upgrades (8 levels),
Industrialization to turn gray towns into new destinations,
local or online multiplayer up to 6 players,
Built-in map editor,

Follow development:
